newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra says FDA move strengthens patents.
newsitem.headline: Astra says FDA move strengthens patents.

text.p: Swedish drug company Astra AB said on Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) updating of Astra's anti-ulcer drug Losec patents concerned existing patents, not new ones.
Astra also said the move strengthened the patents for Losec but did not prolong them.
"These are not new patents. Instead what is happening is that the FDA is including them in their 'Orange Book'. This is a sign that the patents are strong," Astra spokesman John Ahlmark told Reuters.
The updating could scare off potential new producers of Losec who are considering beginning to produce the drug before the expiration of its patent.
"This can have a psychological effect. This should deter someone from starting to produce Losec before the expiration of the patent," Ahlmark said.
Astra said earlier that the FDA updated its approved drugs list with another three patents for Losec.
